queries.name: clean_arm
queries.text: a gloved hand cleans the inside of the patient's elbow with a cotton swab

queries.name: prepare_needle
queries.text: a gloved hand holds a needle and removes its plastic cap

queries.name: insert_needle
queries.text: a nurse inserts the needle into the patient's arm

queries.name: attach_tube
queries.text: a gloved hand pushes a blood collection tube into the needle holder

queries.name: collect_blood
queries.text: dark red blood flows into the blood collection tube

queries.name: change_tube
queries.text: a gloved hand pulls the filled blood tube out of the holder

queries.name: apply_tourniquet
queries.text: a nurse ties a blue tourniquet around the patient's upper arm
queries.opposes: tourniquet is already tied at t=0 and is never applied on camera

queries.name: remove_tourniquet
queries.text: a nurse unties and removes the blue tourniquet from the patient's arm
queries.opposes: tourniquet is still tied at t=83 and is never removed on camera

queries.name: withdraw_needle
queries.text: a nurse pulls the needle out of the patient's arm
queries.opposes: p3 insert_needle; the needle is never withdrawn on camera

queries.name: press_cotton
queries.text: a gloved hand presses a cotton ball on the puncture site after the needle is removed
queries.opposes: p1 clean_arm; same objects, but this never happens

queries.name: mri
queries.text: a patient lies inside an MRI scanner

queries.name: blood_pressure
queries.text: a doctor measures blood pressure with an inflatable cuff and a stethoscope

queries.name: xray
queries.text: a radiologist looks at a chest X-ray on a light box
